hints.telescope: Hold one eye to a long tube on a stand, twist the focus ring, point up at the sky and show amazement.
hints.hourglass: Show a shape narrow at the middle, tip it over, and make sand trickle down with your fingers while you wait.
hints.vacuum cleaner: Push a noisy machine back and forth on the floor, shake with the motor's vibration, and suck up a crumb.
hints.compass: Hold a small flat thing in your palm, watch a needle swing and settle, then turn and point to show the direction.
hints.typewriter: Strike keys one at a time with stiff fingers, then slide a carriage back with a ding and roll the paper.
hints.stapler: Hold one hand flat as a base, press hard on it with the other, and show papers being clamped together with a clack.
hints.kaleidoscope: Hold a tube to one eye, twist it slowly and show colorful patterns changing, with a delighted face.
hints.parachute: Jump from high up, fall, yank a cord over your shoulder, then float down gently holding straps above you.
hints.scissors: Make a V with two fingers and snip open and shut as you cut through a piece of paper.
hints.toothbrush: Brush your teeth with a finger, front and back and up and down, then rinse and spit.
hints.ladder: Show a tall frame leaning on a wall, climb it rung by rung with wobbly hands, and reach up high.
hints.guitar: Hold a wide neck with one hand and strum across the body with the other, with a rocker's pose.
hints.backpack: Pull on two straps over your shoulders, hunch under a heavy load, and zip it shut behind you.
hints.hammer: Hold a nail and swing a heavy object down onto it again and again, and wince when you hit your finger.
hints.mirror: Face someone and copy every move at the same time, so they feel like they are seeing themselves.
hints.chair: Bend your knees as if sitting on nothing, lean back, then rock on two legs.
hints.key: Put a small thing into a lock, turn it, and push the door open.
hints.umbrella: Hold a handle, push up a big canopy over your head, and walk in the rain.
hints.spoon: Scoop something from a bowl, lift it to your mouth, and feed a baby.
hints.clock: Circle your arms like hands around a face and swing one arm side to side like a pendulum.
hints.book: Hold your flat hands like covers, turn pages, and move your eyes along the lines.
hints.shoe: Slip a foot in, bend down, tie the laces in a bow, and stomp.
hints.broom: Hold a long handle with both hands and sweep side to side, then gather the dust and tip it away.
hints.binoculars: Hold two small tubes to your eyes, twist to focus, and scan the horizon.
hints.candle: Light a small wick, cup a hand around the flame, and watch the wax drip down.
hints.sewing machine: Sit at a table, press a pedal with your foot, guide fabric under a fast needle, and snip the thread.
hints.magnifying glass: Hold a round lens close to one eye, bend over a tiny thing, and look amazed at how big it is.
hints.metronome: Stand a small triangle on a table and sway one finger side to side in steady beats.
hints.corkscrew: Twist a spiral into a bottle top, pull hard until it pops out, then pour.
hints.pocket watch: Pull a chain from your vest, flip open a small lid, glance at it, and snap it shut.
